correctness.rationale: For positive solutions, \(H=u+v/c\) obeys \(\dot H+mH\le (r+m)^2/(4a)\); the no-cycle Dulac divergence is \(-[a+r\alpha/D^2]/v-\eta/u<0\). The unique nullcline intersection follows from strict decrease of the prey per-capita function in both variables. At coexistence \(J_{11}<0\), \(J_{12}<0\), \(J_{21}>0\), \(J_{22}\le0\), so trace is negative and determinant positive. The origin and prey-axis invariant-manifold geometry rules out a boundary cycle; planar limit-set classification yields the global attractor dichotomy. At threshold, the center expansion has \(q=\eta+h\kappa/\sigma>0\), giving \(t\,v(t)\to1/q\) and \(t(u(t)-u_1)\to-\kappa/(\sigma q)\). The provided verifier was executed from its package path and confirmed general symbolic identities, 648 rational grids, two exact coexistence examples, and finite numerical asymptotic illustrations. Finite runs are not substituted for infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The August 2026 motivating paper establishes local but not global coexistence dynamics and explicitly poses rigorous global stability and the weak-interference limit as open directions. The all-positive-initial-data threshold, global no-cycle argument, and exact critical universal inverse-time coefficients are not stated there. He–Li (2022) proves global stability for a distinct logistic-prey/fear law with different predator-interference mechanism; Wang–Zanette–Zou (2016) allows cyclic behavior in another response model; Hou–Baigent (2015) presents abstract Kolmogorov criteria rather than the combined model-specific classification or extinction constant. Standard phase-plane and center-manifold methods are prior methods, not novel inventions. Literature searches and the indexed record found no direct covering theorem; unindexed general subsumption remains a stated risk.
residual_risks: An unindexed paper or uninspected sufficiently general Kolmogorov theorem may already imply model-specific convergence.
Some related full manuscripts (including Wang–Zanette–Zou 2016) were not exhaustively available/read; implications beyond accessible abstracts are not asserted.
Standard Dulac and center-manifold principles are classical; the assessed originality attaches only to the combined specific model theorem and explicit sharp extinction coefficient.

value.rationale: The motivating 2026 article explicitly requests a rigorous global analysis and raises the possibility of Hopf behavior when predator interference tends to zero. The finding resolves those issues for its specified system and supplies a sharp universal inverse-time extinction coefficient at the ecological invasion transition. This is a full natural phase diagram with an interpretable critical timescale, rather than a routine parameter check, a finite-only table or a generic method claim. Its value is limited to the specific deterministic response law, and it asserts no field validation or applicability to other functional responses.
